durableLessons: Never merge a stale recovery branch wholesale when current main has moved materially; classify every changed file.
Provider-live useful work can be recovered with history receipts plus a new forward canonical migration when the old executable carries retired dependencies.
A compatibility view is not necessarily a valid foreign-key target; verify relation kind and bind to a real canonical table/registry.
Run new migrations inside BEGIN/ROLLBACK against the live schema before PR review when safe and read-only to persistent state.
After applying a merged migration, reconcile provider-generated migration versions back into source as no-op history receipts.
Do not mark the tracker task done until source merge, provider readback, provenance reconciliation, Memory evidence, and final main readback are all complete.
